name: Since By Man
label: Revelation
lede: Milwaukee's math-damaged hardcore band put dance beats under breakdowns for Revelation, booked tours with The Bled and Bear vs. Shark, and quit when the third album wouldn't come.

eras.title: Milwaukee's turn-of-the-century renaissance
eras.text: Milwaukee hardcore was having a moment around 1999, with Akarso and Seven Days of Samsara packing rooms. Since By Man skipped the fast-simple-hard rulebook of the 1980s and went for '90s math rock and Fugazi-style left turns.

years.h: Since By Man form in Milwaukee
years.p: Singer Sam Macon's five-piece starts out on demos, 7"s and splits, with dense songs that swing from brutal breakdowns to soft, intricate bridges.
years.xp: The Shepherd Express described Macon's vocals as pained, harrowingly human screams. The band churned through several bass players and one guitarist before settling into a stable line-up around 2003.

eras.title: Three records for Revelation
eras.text: Revelation signed the first of what Milwaukee Record calls three Milwaukee bands on the label. Since By Man made an electronic-tinged debut, stripped it back on an EP, then combined the two.

years.h: We Sing the Body Electric · Revelation REV 112
years.p: Since By Man's debut full-length: ten songs and an intro in about 35 minutes. Punknews placed it between a much heavier [[Thursday|0acae232-d31a-4211-b6d0-6af1b6350274]] and a less technical [[The Dillinger Escape Plan|1bc41dff-5397-4c53-bb50-469d2c277197]].
years.xp: Revelation's first pressing was 300 on pink vinyl and 800 on black.

years.h: A Love Hate Relationship EP drops the electronics
years.p: A four-song EP on Revelation. Exclaim! noted it stripped away the debut's electronics for a purely natural, slightly sloppier sound.

q: We wanted it to look like a demo CD.
years.h: Pictures from the Hotel Apocalypse, made to look like a demo
years.p: Matt Bayles was booked to produce and pulled out; Dave Gardner stepped in. Ashley Chapman of Red Knife Lottery sings on two songs, and one breakdown rides a dance beat.
years.xp:
Guitarist Brad Clifford said Gardner got interesting tones and kept it gritty. The sleeve was deliberately bare, interior photos and not much else.

Exclaim! heard Refused-influenced hardcore with electronics; Punknews reached for Refused, Dillinger, Vaux and mewithoutYou.

eras.title: Growing apart
eras.text: Since By Man spent the post-album stretch on the road, then stalled on the third record. After a year and a half of doing nothing they called it, and played one last Milwaukee show.

years.h: Since By Man book three months with The Bled, then Europe
years.p: After a month-long album-release tour, Since By Man line up a three-month North American run with [[The Bled|4b3a2868-4576-4ee8-8c59-c13fc7c4038e]] from February and a European tour with [[Bear vs. Shark|5562ec93-7fa0-4a5d-a8a5-f3a6d3ca8de3]] in April and May.
years.xp: Along the way the band shared stages with [[Andrew W.K.|ef2d4a1c-195e-41f4-839e-bdfd3f85adc3]], [[The (International) Noise Conspiracy|97da5eb3-79a5-4195-b98e-3d10ef946b08]] and [[The Rapture|3697647f-1839-479e-98a1-9ad39004d923]].

years.big: No third album. Creatively, we were growing apart.
years.h: Since By Man break up on MySpace
years.p: After 18 months without activity, Since By Man announce their breakup on MySpace. Sam Macon said writing had become stressful and the third album wouldn't come.

years.h: Since By Man's last show at the Bay View Post
years.p: Since By Man play a final Milwaukee show at the Bay View Post with Seven Days of Samsara, Call Me Lightning and Decibully.
years.xp: Sam Macon moved to Chicago to work in film and co-directed a documentary. Other members went on to The Response, No Future, Hot Coffin and [[Poison the Well|5275425d-3cdb-4a9a-b9eb-3e246ec69881]].
